missing_outcome: source_heldout label that marks a semantically wrong high-confidence SAM proposal as wrong
same-domain null outcome when no source32 proposal corresponds to the text query

rejected_substitutes.cross_view_geometry_self_consistency: Can label same/different/unknown geometry but cannot distinguish the wrong object that is consistently visible in many views.
rejected_substitutes.masked_crop_text_score: It is already a predictor and cannot also serve as an independent proper-scoring outcome.
rejected_substitutes.LERF_target_masks: Forbidden for training, calibration, threshold choice, or source gate.

scene0001_to_scene0004_missing_core_tabl.reason: They use source instance labels and canonical-region/native-V3 missing-support units, not source32 official-SAM proposals or LERF text-instance outcomes.

decision.reason: No independent same-domain proper-scoring outcome exists; training on self-consistency would reinforce a wrong but multi-view-consistent instance.
decision.next_required_data: Source-only object identity annotations or an independently labelled source-heldout text-instance correspondence cohort generated on the exact source32 proposal domain.

value_assessment: The proposal reliability direction remains high-value for LERF3D, where the frozen reliable-component sentinel improved the two-scene weighted mIoU over both deterministic and latent controls. Its remaining blocker is supervision identity, not proposal features, field capacity, or compute.
